caption:
How many people eat dinner at your place? Comment a number.

Each household member gets their own preferences and allergens (the 14 EU allergen categories). Suggestions only show recipes with confirmed absence of the selected allergens, and shopping is counted for everyone at once. With allergies, check important decisions with a doctor.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.
